chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Eat grapes one by one, for it is more wholesome and easier."

key_terms.أَمْرَأُ: Easier, more manageable, or less burdensome

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating grapes one by one according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) recommends consuming grapes one by one, highlighting their superior taste (*ahna'*) and ease of consumption (*amra'*). This advice reflects the Prophetic emphasis on mindful eating and the medicinal benefits of natural foods, a theme frequently elaborated upon in Shia hadith literature regarding dietary health (*tibb*). The specific mention of grapes underscores their status as a blessed fruit in Islamic tradition, often associated with the fruits of Paradise.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-82 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said,
“Eat grapes one by one, for it is more wholesome and easier."
